koku.name: Koku
koku.text: Rice measured for a year of service. Feeds every soldier you keep.

iron.name: Iron
iron.text: Bar stock for blades, plate and cannon.

timber.name: Timber
timber.text: Beams, carriages, siege frames and palisades.

silver.name: Silver
silver.text: Coin for oaths, contracts and recruiters.

KEEP.name: Keep
KEEP.text: Your seat. No other building may exceed the Keep's level.

MINE.name: Iron Mine
MINE.text: Cut into the ridge. Ore for the forge.

SAWPIT.name: Sawpit
SAWPIT.text: Timber for carriages, frames and walls.

BARRACKS.name: Barracks
BARRACKS.text: Every level raises the Army Capacity you may field.

RESEARCH_HALL.name: Research Hall
RESEARCH_HALL.text: Unlocks and speeds research. Its level gates the research tiers you may attempt.

RECRUITMENT_HALL.name: Recruitment Hall
RECRUITMENT_HALL.text: Draws for new cards. Higher levels lift the floor of every draw.

FORGE.name: Forge
FORGE.text: Every level adds attack to units that carry forged steel.

STABLE.name: Stable
STABLE.text: Horses, drakes and their handlers. Raises cavalry weight.

WALL.name: Curtain Wall
WALL.text: Raises the defence of every unit you field.

SHRINE.name: Ritual Shrine
SHRINE.text: Prepared ground. Raises the Fusion charges you carry into battle and speeds rituals.
